taken_branch.source:
addi x1, x0, 1
beq x1, x1, target
addi x2, x0, 11
addi x2, x0, 99
ecall
target:
addi x3, x2, 1
csrrw x0, x3, 0x7c0
ecall

delay_branch_and_delay_slot.source:

delay 3

delay 2
ecall
target:

ecall

not_taken_then_taken.source:

bne x1, x1, target
beq x0, x0, target
nop
ecall
target:
csrrw x0, x1, 0x7c0
ecall

nop

backward_branch_loop.source:
li x1, 3
li x2, 0
loop:
addi x2, x2, 1
addi x1, x1, -1
bne x1, x0, loop
addi x2, x2, 10
csrrw x0, x2, 0x7c0
ecall
